This site explains three UX research methods that help teams find problems, organize content, and test designs. Each guide gives you the steps to run the method yourself and shows a real project as an example.

## Guides

[How to Run a Heuristic Evaluation of a Website](page1.qmd)
: Review a website against established usability principles to find problems before a redesign. Example: Flame Kabob restaurant website.

[How to Run a Closed Card Sort](page2.qmd)
: Test whether your site's categories match how users expect content to be grouped. Example: Natural Beauty cosmetics website and app.

[How to Run a Usability Test and Score It with SUS](page3.qmd)
: Compare two designs using real tasks, error counts, and a standard satisfaction score. Example: Parks Library study room booking redesign.

## Who this is for

These guides are for students and beginners in UX design who want a quick, practical starting point. No special software is needed.
